description: This file defines a mock class for the IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService interface, used for testing media pipeline capabilities in the Rialto server IPC component. It includes mock methods for client connection management and MIME type support queries.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Mocks the clientConnected method, simulating a client connection event.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Mocks the clientDisconnected method, simulating a client disconnection event.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Mocks the getSupportedMimeTypes method, simulating a request to retrieve supported MIME types.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Mocks the isMimeTypeSupported method, simulating a check for MIME type support.
